fields.name: Attempts
fields.evidence: Toolkit EoCClient.dll+0x5AB710 ecl::multiplayer::DropInApprovalSystem::UpdateComponents: keys stride 4 and removal looks keys up by ls::FixedString::GetHash; values stride 0x40 with the variant index byte at +0x38 (0 = client, 1 = host; destroying alt 1 destroys the STDString at +0x10); bounds assert names ls::IndexedStorage<ls::Variant<ecl::multiplayer::ToApproveInfoClient, ecl::multiplayer::ToApproveInfoHost>>. MSVC std::variant puts the index after the 0x38-byte largest alternative, i.e. the same layout. macOS default: zeroed 64 bytes; live: empty.
